title: allSeriesKey = JSON.stringify(allSeries) recomputed every render despite single effect-only use
description: allSeriesKey is computed unconditionally on every render via JSON.stringify, but its sole consumer is the dependency array of the checked-series sync effect (lines 454-457, with exhaustive-deps disabled). Since allSeries is already a memoized stable reference (lines 424-431), the effect could simply depend on allSeries directly (set membership re-syncs only when the memo identity changes), removing both the per-render stringify and the eslint-disable. If a value-based key is genuinely desired it should be wrapped in useMemo keyed on allSeries.
evidence: Line 434: const allSeriesKey = JSON.stringify(allSeries) — runs on every render. Lines 454-457: useEffect(() => { setCheckedSeries(new Set(allSeries)) /* eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps */ }, [allSeriesKey]). allSeries memoized at 424-431 on [objectiveCol, constraintCols], so its reference already changes iff the series list changes.
est_reduction: 1 line + 1 eslint-disable removed, plus a per-render JSON.stringify
behavior_preservation: Depending on allSeries identity instead of its JSON string preserves behaviour because allSeries is memoized and only re-created when the series list changes; the resulting Set re-sync timing is identical.
